summary.en: A new Chinese spy drama, 'Long Watch' (Jiaofeng), co-produced by the Ministry of State Security, has become a hit across the Taiwan Strait. The show, which fictionalizes real-life crises, follows a double agent working for China whose cover is blown. While dismissed as propaganda in Taiwan, the series' success...
summary.zh: 一部由国家安全部联合制作的中国新间谍剧《交锋》（Jiaofeng）已成为海峡两岸的热门剧集。该剧将现实生活中的危机虚构化，讲述了一名在中国大陆秘密工作的双面间谍被揭穿的故事。尽管在台湾被斥为宣传片，但该剧的成功凸显了娱乐媒体在处理敏感政治话题方面的作用。

body.en: Dismissed in Taiwan as simply propaganda, the Long Watch, or Jiaofeng, has proved a sensation across the strait with its references to real-life crises After shaking off the people trailing her through a crowded market and emerging from a bathroom in disguise, the double agent appears to have escaped. But a sip of water on a plane eventually gets her. She is poisoned after Taiwan’s military intelligence service discovers that she has been working secretly for China. The plot comes from a new Chinese spy drama co-produced by the Ministry of State Security. Since its premiere on 6 September, it has become a TV hit, with a fictionalised take on a subject rarely treated so directly: the modern history of tensions with Taiwan. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在台湾，《长守》或《叫风》被认为只是宣传品，但它却因提及现实生活中的危机而轰动了海峡两岸。在摆脱了跟踪她的人穿过拥挤的市场，乔装打扮地从浴室里出来后，这位双重间谍似乎已经逃脱了。但飞机上的一小口水最终让她崩溃了。台湾军事情报部门发现她一直在为中国大陆秘密工作后，她被毒死。剧情来自于国家安全部联合制作的一部新的中国谍战剧。自 9 月 6 日首播以来，它已成为电视热门节目，以虚构的方式讲述了一个很少如此直接处理的主题：与台湾紧张关系的现代历史。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This drama, 'Long Watch,' produced with the involvement of China's Ministry of State Security, uses fictionalized events to explore cross-strait tensions. It raises questions about how narratives are shaped and disseminated through popular media, reminding us of the importance of discerning truth from fiction, as Ephesians 4:25 urges us to speak truthfully...
reflection.zh: 这部由中国国家安全部参与制作的《交锋》剧集，通过虚构的情节来探讨海峡两岸的紧张局势。它引发了关于叙事如何通过大众媒体塑造和传播的疑问，提醒我们要分辨真伪，正如以弗所书4章25节所劝勉的，要说诚实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: 'Still gets the heart going': What I learned from over 50,000 Australian Magpie swoopings
title.zh: “仍能让心跳加速”：我从五万多次澳大利亚喜鹊袭击事件中学到的东西

summary.en: A community-led tracking network is helping Australians navigate high-risk neighbourhood zones as peak swooping season begins. Sydney web developer Jon Clark admits that being swooped by a magpie "still gets the heart going" despite having logged tens of thousands of public encounters with defensive birds. After a...
summary.zh: 一个社区主导的追踪网络正在帮助澳大利亚人在掠夺季节高峰期应对高风险的社区区域。悉尼的网页开发者乔恩·克拉克承认，尽管他记录了数万次与具有攻击性的鸟类的公开遭遇，但被喜鹊掠夺“仍能让心跳加速”。在2013年一次“绝对可怕”的遭遇后，克拉克利用自己的技术技能创建了社区驱动的数据库“喜鹊警报”，该网站已成为全国关于具有攻击性...

body.en:
Sydney web developer Jon Clark admits that being swooped by a magpie "still gets the heart going" despite having logged tens of thousands of public encounters with defensive birds.

After an "absolutely terrifying" encounter with a swooping magpie in 2013, Clark decided to put his technical skills to use by creating the community-driven database, Magpie Alert. The website has since become the nation's pre-eminent go-to for up-to-date information on aggressive magpies.

"I was just out on my bicycle one Sunday afternoon, minding my own business in the spring, and this great big magpie decided to start snapping at my ear," he told SBS News. "It was the first time I'd ever experienced it, and gosh, it scared me senseless."

Discovering that the information for logging and tracking the locations of dangerous magpies was "pretty limited", Clark built his site, which he says "took off" in 2016. He has since been contacted by local councils and Australia Post branches who are interested in helping communities stay alert about magpies in the area.

Users can file a report on any aggressive magpie they have encountered, tagging the location of the bird, the type of attack, and the time of the incident. Others can corroborate this information and share updates on whether the bird is still active in the area.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As a British person who migrated to Australia some 15 years ago, Clark said the prevailing impression of Australia is that "everything's out to kill you". Having become accustomed to the relative lack of danger presented by the fauna populating the suburbs of north-west Sydney, assault by magpie came as a surprise.

"I was like, 'God, we've got sharks, we've got jellyfish, we've got snakes, spiders, and even the garden birds are out to get you'."

Magpie Alert data shows that September is the peak of swooping season. The website receives some 4,000 to 6,000 submissions each year, with around 45,000 users logging on to read the latest updates.

While magpies swoop right across the country, the ACT has the highest rate of incidents, something Clark attributes to having a high number of cyclists.

Behavioural ecologist Darryl Jones, who has been studying magpies for more than 30 years, told SBS News that the birds are drawn to human-created environments and have become concentrated in places where they can be supported by the local ecosystem.

"In the suburbs, there's everything they need in a small area," Jones said. "They're just pulling grubs and worms out of the ground and all they need is a lawn that gets watered and mown all the time."

Only a small fraction of magpies swoop. Those that do are always male and will...
body.zh: 悉尼网络开发者乔恩·克拉克（Jon Clark）承认，尽管已经记录了数以万计的公众与防御性鸟类的遭遇，但被喜鹊猛扑“仍然让人心潮澎湃”。 2013 年，克拉克与猛扑而来的喜鹊发生了一次“绝对可怕”的遭遇后，克拉克决定利用自己的技术技能，创建社区驱动的数据库 Magpie Alert。此后，该网站已成为该国获取有关喜鹊的最新信息的首选网站。 他告诉 SBS 新闻：“一个周日下午，我刚骑着自行车出去，忙着自己的春天生意，这只巨大的喜鹊决定开始在我的耳朵上撕咬。” “这是我第一次经历这种事，天哪，它把我吓得失去知觉。” 发现用于记录和跟踪危险喜鹊位置的信息“相当有限”，克拉克建立了自己的网站，他说该网站于 2016 年“起飞”。此后，当地议会和澳大利亚邮政分支机构联系了他，他们有兴趣帮助社区对该地区的喜鹊保持警惕。 用户可以提交有关他们遇到的任何攻击性喜鹊的报告，标记喜鹊的位置、攻击类型和事件发生时间。其他人可以证实这一信息，并分享有关这只鸟是否仍然在该地区活跃的最新信息。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 作为大约 15 年前移居澳大利亚的英国人，克拉克表示，澳大利亚的普遍印象是“一切都在杀了你”。人们已经习惯了悉尼西北部郊区的动物群相对较少的危险，喜鹊的袭击让人感到意外。 “我当时想，‘天啊，我们有鲨鱼、我们有水母、我们有蛇、蜘蛛，甚至花园里的鸟儿也想来抓你’。” 喜鹊警报数据显示，9月是喜鹊俯冲季节的高峰期。该网站每年收到约 4,000 至 6,000 份提交内容，约有 45,000 名用户登录阅读最新更新。 虽然喜鹊在全国范围内肆虐，但首都地区的事故发生率最高，克拉克将其归因于骑自行车的人数量较多。 研究喜鹊超过 30 年的行为生态学家达里尔·琼斯 (Darryl Jones) 告诉 SBS 新闻，喜鹊被人类创造的环境所吸引，并集中在可以得到当地生态系统支持的地方。 “在郊区，他们需要的一切都集中在一个小区域内，”琼斯说。 “他们只是把幼虫和蠕虫从地里拔出来，他们所需要的只是一块经常浇水和修剪的草坪。” 只有一小部分喜鹊会猛扑。那些这样做的人总是男性，并且会......

reflection.en: The fear of being swooped by a magpie, even after thousands of encounters, can be unsettling. Jon Clark's creation of Magpie Alert demonstrates a constructive response to this common anxiety. By focusing on what is true, honorable, and helpful—sharing information and creating a community resource—we can manage fear and navigate challenging situations with...
reflection.zh: 即使在经历了数千次遭遇后，对被喜鹊掠夺的恐惧仍然可能令人不安。乔恩·克拉克创建“喜鹊警报”数据库，是对这种普遍焦虑的建设性回应。通过专注于真实、可敬和有益的事物——分享信息并创建一个社区资源——我们可以管理恐惧，并在更平静的心态下应对挑战性的情况。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: John Farnham to skip tribute concert amid worsening health, family says
title.zh: 约翰·芬恩姆因健康状况恶化将缺席致敬音乐会

summary.en: Australian music legend John Farnham will not attend a tribute concert in his honor due to his deteriorating health. The 77-year-old, who has undergone treatment for oral cancer, now requires constant oxygen and round-the-clock care. The concert will proceed as a charity event to raise funds for cancer support...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚音乐传奇人物约翰·芬恩姆因健康状况恶化将无法出席向他致敬的音乐会。这位77岁的艺术家曾接受过口腔癌治疗，目前需要持续的氧气供应和全天候护理。音乐会仍将如期举行，并将作为一项慈善活动，为癌症支持服务筹集资金。

body.en:
John Farnham's tribute concert will go ahead without him as the Australian music legend's family reveals his health has deteriorated.

The music-industry giant will be honoured by local and international performing greats at a blockbuster charity gig at Melbourne's Rod Laver Arena on Sunday, raising funds for the cancer support services that helped him through his own battle with the disease.

The 77-year-old, who has undergone several surgeries for oral cancer, now requires continuous oxygen support and 24-hour care.

A day before the sold-out event, Farnham's wife Jill and the couple's sons Robert and James, said they were "deeply moved by everything happening" at Rod Laver Arena.

"John's health has deteriorated in recent months," read a family statement posted to social media.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"It has also become necessary for John to receive 24-hour nursing care at home, ensuring trained support is always available when he needs it.

"We have kept these matters private while our family has adjusted to John's changing needs.

"However, we now feel it is important that John's fans and supporters understand his circumstances and why he cannot be there this weekend."

The charity event sold out within hours of going on sale, with premium tickets priced at $1,650.

The concert is being held to raise funds for Head and Neck Cancer Australia, which supported the much-loved singer when he was diagnosed with a cancerous tumour in his mouth.

Farnham underwent a 12-hour operation to remove the growth in 2022 and was later given the all-clear by his medical team .

The concert is expected to make a significant contribution to supporting Australians affected by these types of cancers, the charity previously told the Australian Associated Press.

Jimmy Barnes, Tina Arena, Human Nature, Keith Urban and Jessica Mauboy are among the names listed to appear at the gig.

The You're The Voice singer would have loved nothing more than to attend the concert, his family added in their statement.

"He would undoubtedly have been a little overwhelmed by all the fuss, but he would also have wanted to thank everyone involved in person," Farnham's family said.

"As a family, we have decided that it is best for John to remain at home, where he can be safe and comfortable.

"Thank you for your understanding and for the many messages of love and support John continues to receive."

body.zh: 约翰·法纳姆的致敬音乐会将在没有他的情况下继续进行，因为这位澳大利亚音乐传奇人物的家人透露他的健康状况已经恶化。 周日，这位音乐产业巨头将在墨尔本罗德·拉沃尔竞技场举行一场轰动一时的慈善演出，受到当地和国际表演巨星的表彰，为癌症支持服务筹集资金，帮助他战胜疾病。 这位77岁的老人因口腔癌接受了多次手术，现在需要持续的氧气支持和24小时护理。 在门票全部售完的活动前一天，法纳姆的妻子吉尔以及这对夫妇的儿子罗伯特和詹姆斯表示，他们对罗德拉沃尔竞技场“发生的一切深感感动”。 “近几个月来，约翰的健康状况恶化了，”发布在社交媒体上的一份家庭声明写道。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “约翰还需要在家接受 24 小时护理，以确保在他需要时始终可以获得经过培训的支持。 “我们对这些事情保密，而我们的家人已经适应了约翰不断变化的需求。 “然而，我们现在认为，约翰的球迷和支持者了解他的情况以及他本周末不能到场的原因很重要。” 这场慈善活动在发售后数小时内就被抢购一空，高级门票售价为 1,650 美元。 举办这场音乐会的目的是为澳大利亚头颈癌组织筹集资金，当这位深受喜爱的歌手被诊断出口腔中患有癌性肿瘤时，该组织为他提供了支持。 2022 年，法纳姆接受了长达 12 小时的手术，去除了肿瘤，随后他的医疗团队解除了疾病。 该慈善机构此前告诉澳大利亚美联社，预计这场音乐会将为支持受此类癌症影响的澳大利亚人做出重大贡献。 吉米·巴恩斯 (Jimmy Barnes)、蒂娜·阿瑞娜 (Tina Arena)、Human Nature、基思·厄本 (Keith Urban) 和杰西卡·莫博伊 (Jessica Mauboy) 均列于演出现场。 他的家人在声明中补充说，这位《You're The Voice》歌手最喜欢的就是参加这场音乐会。 法纳姆的家人说：“毫无疑问，他会对所有的大惊小怪感到有点不知所措，但他也想亲自感谢所有参与其中的人。” “作为一个家庭，我们决定约翰最好留在家里，这样他才能安全舒适。 “感谢您的理解以及约翰继续收到的许多爱与支持的信息。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: Even as the body wears down, a spirit of gratitude and celebration can endure. John Farnham's family expresses being 'deeply moved' by the tribute, showing that even in physical decline, the impact of a life's work and the love of others can bring comfort and strength. This reminds us that while our outward selves may fade, an inner renewal can be sustained...
reflection.zh: 即使身体日渐衰弱，感恩和庆祝的精神依然可以延续。约翰·芬恩姆的家人表示对这场致敬演出“深受感动”，这表明即使在身体衰退之时，一生事业的影响力以及他人的爱也能带来慰藉和力量。这提醒我们，虽然外体日渐朽坏，但内心的更新可以依靠爱与社群来维系。

verse.textEn: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.
verse.textZh: 所以，我们不丧胆。外体虽然毁坏，内心却一天新似一天。

title.en: The future of this Australian island is in danger. How its residents are fighting back
title.zh: 这个澳大利亚岛屿的未来岌岌可危。居民们如何奋起反击

summary.en: From coconuts to cultural knowledge, a new Indigenous Protected Area is helping Masig buffer against the tide.
summary.zh: 从椰子到文化知识，一个新的原住民保护区正在帮助马西格岛抵御潮水的侵袭。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Yessie Mosby paces down the beach near his home on Masig, a teardrop-shaped island in the Torres Strait.

As he walks, he points to the crimson fruit of a wongai tree, a marooned yellow rowboat and a tree trunk full of hiding holes — hallmarks of his generations-long connection to this spot.

The Kulkalgal man recalls a day in 2017, when his son recovered the washed-up remains of his great-great-grandmother while playing in the sand.

"They were picking up her bones like shells off the beach. My son grabbed her skull and placed her in a bucket," he says.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Less than three metres above sea level, Masig's sandy shores are slowly being eaten away by rising tides. Areas once safely inland, such as burial sites, playgrounds, roads and family gardens, are receding before its residents' eyes.

The most dire scientific predictions give the Torres Strait's low-lying islands, including Masig, until 2050 before they become uninhabitable. But Mosby, a climate advocate and chair of the Masigalgal Prescribed Body Corporate (a legal entity that holds and manages native title rights on behalf of Traditional Owners), has taken to measuring the encroaching tides in real time.

"When I was young, the island was here," the 43-year-old says, using the sand as a slate to draw a line.

But with the birth of each of his seven children, now aged five to 15 years, that mark has edged further inland.

"That loved one should be resting in peace. She shouldn't be washed out into the sea," he says.

Five years later, in 2022, Mosby was among eight Torres Strait Islanders who won a landmark UN human rights ruling against the Australian government over climate change inaction. The group have been calling for urgent action to protect Masig and its neighbouring islands.

Over the past decade, the federal and Queensland governments have invested millions in the Torres Strait Seawalls Program, installing thousands of sandbags to mitigate coastal erosion. On Masig, they wrap around the island's northwestern side to form a seawall.

One way Traditional Owners are seeking to take back control of their future is by establishing a new Indigenous Protected Area (IPA). Unlike other conservation zones, such as national parks or marine reserves, IPAs are voluntarily declared and managed by First Nations Australians.

summary.en: A new mum in the Senate is putting parliament's support for working parents to the test.
summary.zh: 参议院的一位新晋母亲正在考验议会对职场父母的支持。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

The sun is still hours from rising, but Western Australian senator Fatima Payman is already on her first coffee, getting ready for another day of work — and caring for a newborn. 

It could be 2am or 3am. She isn't sure anymore. These days, she says time is more of a concept than a clock.

The independent senator isn't just working to an east coast time zone from Perth; she's working around the unpredictable schedule of a new mum.

"Some days it is really tough, and there are some really good days," Payman tells SBS News during an interview in Perth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Payman is the first WA senator to have a baby while serving in parliament — a distinction that comes with its own challenges, including the more than 3,600km distance between Perth and Canberra.

Between herself and her husband, Jacob Stokes, a former WA Labor staffer, Payman says they are juggling the demands of parenthood with support from their respective families in Perth.

Their daughter, Aliyah, was born in May this year, the couple's first child, and the family spent the first four months in Perth before Payman returned to Canberra to work earlier this month.

Payman's experience highlights a question that goes beyond one senator: As more women enter politics, has parliament changed enough to accommodate the realities of having a family?

Payman's working day now unfolds around the needs of a newborn, with the routines of motherhood squeezed between emails, meetings and the demands of parliamentary work.

There are feeds, nappy changes and playtime, followed by putting Aliyah to sleep and expressing breast milk to ensure there is enough for the day.

In between, Payman reads emails, keeps up to date with political developments and attends virtual meetings.

By the afternoon, she is often driving to community meetings and other events, sometimes with Aliyah in the baby seat, before returning home for the evening routine.

After Aliyah was born, Payman says she did not take an extended break from work.

"I didn't have a maternity leave; it was really right back to work as soon as I could, answering calls," she says.

As an independent senator, Payman's circumstances differ from those of senators in larger political parties, where responsibilities can be shared among multiple members.

She became an independent after crossing the floor in June 2024 to support a motion recognising Palestinian statehood. She resigned from the Labor Party the following month and, in October 2024, launched her own political party , Australia's Voice.

"I had various...

reflection.en: Senator Fatima Payman's presence in the Senate with her newborn highlights the ongoing challenge for working parents to balance professional responsibilities with family care. This reality underscores the profound truth that children are a gift, a blessing from Yahweh, and their presence enriches life even amidst demanding schedules.
reflection.zh: 参议员法蒂玛·佩曼带着新生儿出现在参议院，凸显了职场父母在平衡职业责任与家庭照料方面持续面临的挑战。这一现实强调了一个深刻的真理：孩子是雅伟所赐的礼物和祝福，即使在繁忙的日程中，他们的存在也能丰富生活。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: How the government's new migration crackdown could give domestic abusers more power

summary.en: Recently announced changes to the migration system could put domestic violence victim-survivors at greater risk, an expert has warned. The changes, announced after a six-week delay, lack a safety net for victims of domestic and family violence, despite research showing how perpetrators can weaponize the migration...
summary.zh: 一位专家警告说，最近宣布的移民系统变更可能会使家庭暴力受害者幸存者面临更大的风险。这些变更是在六周延迟后宣布的，尽管有研究表明施虐者如何利用移民系统来对付受害者，但这些变更并未为家庭暴力受害者提供安全网。

body.en:
After a six-week delay, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has announced changes to the migration system.

Amid all the analysis and discussion it triggered, there was nothing to indicate an understanding that these changes need to have a safety net for victim-survivors of domestic and family violence .

There has been significant work documenting the connection between temporary migration and domestic and family violence.

This includes the ways the migration system can be weaponised by perpetrators and can punish victim-survivors (including by excluding them from access to support).

The largest national study of migrant and refugee women found that one in three experienced domestic and family violence .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It also found temporary migrants were more likely to experience violence, and specifically violence connected to their visa status.

Migration policy as it is now provides a safety net for women on partner visas with a pathway to permanency — the family violence provisions.

However, many women are in relationships with abusive partners and in many cases have children with perpetrators who do not hold a partner visa. This includes:

In some cases, perpetrators lie about visa status. Women are tricked into believing they hold partner visas, but actually enter the country on visitor visas.

Migrant women who experience violence in Australia are denied many forms of domestic and family violence-related support.

Notably, to date, there is limited commitment to addressing these issues in the National Plan to End Violence Against Women and their children.

In his National Press Club address, Burke announced a number of changes . I highlight just one to show the importance of why recognising the reality of domestic and family violence matters in any changes to migration system settings is urgent.

A key change Burke has announced is a crackdown on overstayers , with the threat of detention facilities to increase deterrence. This matters because, as detailed above, many women overstay their visas without knowing they are doing so.

In the national study of migrant and refugee women, we asked all participants who were temporary visa holders and/or had indicated they had experienced migration-related controlling behaviours about their confidence in their visa rights in Australia.

Notably, only 22 per cent were confident in their knowledge of the visa they held and their rights connected to that visa in Australia.

These changes also provide another way for perpetrators to weaponise this system and threaten women with 'dobbing them in' to have them deported. This already happens at high rates, and the new policy...
body.zh: 推迟六周后，内政部长托尼·伯克宣布对移民制度进行改革。 在它引发的所有分析和讨论中，没有任何迹象表明人们理解这些变化需要为家庭暴力的受害者和幸存者建立一个安全网。 有大量工作记录了临时移民与家庭暴力之间的联系。 这包括移民系统可以被肇事者武器化以及惩罚受害者幸存者的方式（包括阻止他们获得支持）。 对移民和难民妇女进行的最大规模的全国性研究发现，三分之一的人遭受过家庭暴力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 报告还发现，临时移民更有可能遭受暴力，特别是与其签证身份相关的暴力。 现在的移民政策为持有伴侣签证的女性提供了一个安全网，并提供了一条通往永久的途径——家庭暴力条款。 然而，许多妇女与施虐者有关系，并且在许多情况下，他们与没有持有伴侣签证的施暴者生有孩子。这包括： 在某些情况下，肇事者会对签证状况撒谎。女性被欺骗，以为自己持有伴侣签证，但实际上是通过访客签证进入该国的。 在澳大利亚遭受暴力的移民妇女无法获得多种形式的家庭暴力相关支持。 值得注意的是，迄今为止，《终止暴力侵害妇女及其儿童国家计划》对解决这些问题的承诺有限。 伯克在全国新闻俱乐部的讲话中宣布了一些变化。我仅强调其中一个，以表明为什么在移民制度设置的任何变化中认识到家庭暴力的现实至关重要的重要性。 伯克宣布的一项关键改变是打击逾期居留者，并威胁设立拘留设施以增强威慑力。这很重要，因为正如上面详述的，许多女性在不知道自己这样做的情况下逾期居留。 在针对移民和难民妇女的国家研究中，我们询问了所有临时签证持有者和/或曾表示经历过与移民相关的控制行为的参与者对自己在澳大利亚的签证权利的信心。 值得注意的是，只有 22％ 的人对自己所持有的签证以及与该签证在澳大利亚相关的权利的了解充满信心。 这些变化也为犯罪者提供了另一种方式，将这一系统武器化，并威胁妇女“强行介入”，将她们驱逐出境。这种情况已经发生率很高，而新政策......

It is a stark reminder that policy changes must consider the most vulnerable, ensuring that legal frameworks do not become tools of further harm. We are called to defend the oppressed and ensure justice and safety for those...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了一个关键的脆弱性，即本应管理移民的系统可能会无意中赋予施虐者权力。它严峻地提醒我们，政策的变动必须考虑到最脆弱的群体，确保法律框架不被用作进一步伤害的工具。我们蒙召要保护受压迫者，并为那些被困在虐待循环中的人确保正义与安全。

title.en: 'Deeply offensive' to suggest farmers 'prefer to abuse and exploit backpackers', NFF says
title.zh: “暗示农民‘宁愿虐待和剥削背包客’是‘极其冒犯的’”，全国农民联合会表示

summary.en: Australia's peak farming body has strongly criticized Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke's remarks, which suggested farmers might prefer to exploit 'backpackers' rather than utilize the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme. The National Farmers' Federation (NFF) warned that proposed changes to backpacker...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的最高农业机构强烈批评了内政部长托尼·伯克的言论，他暗示农民可能宁愿剥削“背包客”，而不是利用太平洋澳大利亚劳务流动（PALM）计划。全国农民联合会（NFF）警告说，拟议的背包客签证变更可能会影响农业劳动力，并可能导致食品价格上涨。

body.en:
Australia's peak farming body has accused Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke of making "deeply offensive" comments about farmers, as concern grows over how changes to backpacker visas could affect the nation's agricultural workforce.

The National Farmers' Federation (NFF) has warned the changes could contribute to higher food prices if they leave growers without enough workers during key harvest periods — times when farmers often hire 'backpackers' on Working Holiday visas.

While Burke acknowledged the migration changes would create challenges for some, he suggested the agricultural sector could utilise additional capacity in the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme.

The scheme allows eligible Australian businesses to recruit workers from nine Pacific island countries and Timor-Leste when there are not enough local workers available.

Burke also said the strengthening of protections for PALM workers during his tenure as employment minister had led to warnings from some agricultural employers that they would turn away from the PALM scheme.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"At the time that we were improving those rules, we had some of the farm organisations say to us, 'If you do this, our members will just go and use backpackers,'" Burke told SBS News.

"If the reason that people are more reliant on backpackers and refusing to use Pacific workers is because they're upset that we've ended exploitation in those areas, I think that is a very different question for a number of operators."

He also stressed the criticism did not apply to the entire agricultural sector, saying "that doesn't depict the whole of the farm sector, not for a minute".

Richard Shannon, executive officer of the NFF Horticulture Council, labelled Burke's comments as "provocative" and rejected any suggestion that employers had moved away from the PALM scheme because of stronger protections for workers.

"The minister is suggesting that employers in horticulture would prefer to abuse and exploit backpackers than remain in the PALM program," Shannon told SBS News.

"This is not about exploiting people and finding loopholes, and it's deeply offensive."

Shannon argued that the reason some employers had moved away from PALM was because changes to the scheme had increased costs and administrative requirements.

He said backpackers and PALM workers also served different purposes within the agricultural workforce and could not simply be substituted for one another.

Employers in the PALM scheme have responsibilities including arranging accommodation and transport and providing additional support to workers.

body.zh: 澳大利亚农业最高机构指责内政部长托尼·伯克对农民发表“非常无礼”的言论，因为人们越来越担心背包客签证的变化可能会影响该国的农业劳动力。 全国农民联合会（NFF）警告称，如果这些变化导致种植者在关键收获期（农民经常雇用持有工作假期签证的“背包客”）没有足够的工人，可能会导致粮食价格上涨。 虽然伯克承认移民变化会给一些人带来挑战，但他建议农业部门可以利用太平洋澳大利亚劳动力流动（PALM）计划中的额外产能。 当当地工人不足时，该计划允许符合条件的澳大利亚企业从九个太平洋岛国和东帝汶招聘工人。 伯克还表示，在他担任就业部长期间加强了对 PALM 工人的保护，导致一些农业雇主警告他们将放弃 PALM 计划。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “当我们改进这些规则时，一些农场组织对我们说，‘如果你这样做，我们的成员就会去使用背包客，’”伯克告诉 SBS 新闻。 “如果人们更加依赖背包客并拒绝使用太平洋工人的原因是因为他们对我们结束在这些地区的剥削感到不安，我认为这对许多经营者来说是一个非常不同的问题。” 他还强调，批评并不适用于整个农业部门，并表示“这并没有描述整个农业部门，一分钟都没有”。 NFF 园艺委员会执行官理查德·香农 (Richard Shannon) 将伯克的言论称为“挑衅性”，并拒绝任何有关雇主因对工人提供更强有力的保护而放弃 PALM 计划的说法。 香农告诉 SBS 新闻：“部长建议园艺雇主宁愿虐待和剥削背包客，也不愿留在 PALM 计划中。” “这不是剥削人民、寻找漏洞，这是非常令人反感的。” Shannon 认为，一些雇主放弃 PALM 的原因是该计划的变更增加了成本和管理要求。 他说，背包客和 PALM 工人在农业劳动力中也有不同的用途，不能简单地相互替代。 PALM 计划中的雇主有责任安排住宿和交通以及为工人提供额外支持。 香农说，这些要求使得该计划......

title.en: Japan emperor declares Asian Games open following turbulent build-up
title.zh: 日本天皇宣布亚运会开幕，此前经历动荡

summary.en: Japan's emperor declared the 20th Asian Games open on Saturday, following a troubled build-up to the multi-sport event which features more athletes than the Olympics. The opening ceremony in Nagoya's 30,000-capacity stadium was marked by a significant number of empty seats and a subdued atmosphere.
summary.zh: 日本天皇于周六宣布第20届亚洲运动会开幕，此前此次赛事经历了一段动荡的筹备期，该届赛事的运动员人数超过了奥运会。在名古屋可容纳3万人的体育场举行的开幕式，有大量空座，气氛也显得较为沉闷。

body.en: The 20th Asian Games were declared open by Japan’s emperor on Saturday following a troubled build-up to the multi-sport spectacular that has more athletes than the Olympics. The opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games in Japan’s Nagoya on Saturday, September 19, 2026. Photo: SF&OC. There were a large number of empty seats at the 30,000-capacity stadium in Nagoya, where a subdued crowd saw a colourful opening ceremony on a heart-shaped stage. Japan’s Emperor and Empress were given a respectful reception as they took their seats alongside International Olympic Committee president Kirsty Coventry. The opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games in Japan’s Nagoya on Saturday, September 19, 2026. Photo: SF&OC. There was polite applause when Emperor Naruhito declared the Games open. The first gold medal will be won on Sunday morning, likely in the men’s individual triathlon, as the continent’s finest athletes compete in more than 40 sports before the curtain comes down on October 4. The event in Nagoya and Aichi prefecture has 2028 Olympics places up for grabs in seven sports and will be graced by global stars and fast-rising prodigies. The opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games in Japan’s Nagoya on Saturday, September 19, 2026. Photo: SF&OC. But it has been dogged by a series of problems as more than 11,000 athletes and 6,000 officials stretched organisers to the limit as they tried to accommodate all. To save money there is no traditional athletes’ village, competitors instead staying in a combination of temporary container-style huts, hotels and cruise ship the Costa Serena. There was a record deluge last week which flooded parts of Nagoya and now a typhoon is approaching eastern Japan threatening further disruption in the coming days. The opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games in Japan’s Nagoya on Saturday, September 19, 2026. Photo: SF&OC. Some athletes were left stranded at the airport when transport failed to turn up and several teams have complained about the quality of the huts, including the beds being too short. In the latest mishap, North Korea’s national anthem was played on Friday for South Korea’s men’s hockey team. Cheers, empty seats Two-time Asian Games silver medallist Zahra Kiani was a flag-bearer for Iran and hopes to win another medal in the Chinese martial art of wushu — by watching how it’s done on YouTube. “I have been training with movies. I watch videos of Chinese athletes and I try to copy them,” she said. The opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games in Japan’s Nagoya on Saturday, September 19, 2026. Photo: SF&OC. The Olympic Council of Asia said the continent’s premier sporting event, featuring...
body.zh: 日本天皇于周六宣布第 20 届亚运会开幕，此前，这项综合运动会的筹备工作遇到了麻烦，该运动会的运动员数量比奥运会还要多。第 20 届亚运会开幕式于 2026 年 9 月 19 日星期六在日本名古屋举行。照片：SF&OC。名古屋可容纳 30,000 人的体育场内有大量空座位，平静的人群在心形舞台上观看了一场色彩缤纷的开幕式。日本天皇和皇后在国际奥委会主席科斯蒂·考文垂旁边就座，受到了尊敬的接待。第 20 届亚运会开幕式于 2026 年 9 月 19 日星期六在日本名古屋举行。照片：SF&OC。当德仁天皇宣布奥运会开幕时，全场响起礼貌的掌声。第一枚金牌将于周日上午颁发，很可能是男子个人铁人三项赛，非洲大陆最优秀的运动员将在 10 月 4 日落幕之前参加 40 多个项目的角逐。这项在名古屋和爱知县举行的赛事有 7 个项目的 2028 年奥运会参赛资格，全球明星和迅速崛起的天才将云集于此。第 20 届亚运会开幕式于 2026 年 9 月 19 日星期六在日本名古屋举行。照片：SF&OC。但它受到了一系列问题的困扰，超过 11,000 名运动员和 6,000 名官员在试图容纳所有人的过程中使组织者不堪重负。为了省钱，这里没有传统的运动员村，参赛者而是住在临时集装箱式小屋、酒店和歌诗达塞雷纳号游轮的组合中。上周发生了创纪录的洪水，淹没了名古屋部分地区，现在台风正在接近日本东部，可能在未来几天造成进一步的破坏。第 20 届亚运会开幕式于 2026 年 9 月 19 日星期六在日本名古屋举行。照片：SF&OC。由于交通工具未能出现，一些运动员被困在机场，一些球队抱怨小屋的质量，包括床太短。在最近的一次事故中，周五韩国男子曲棍球队演奏了朝鲜国歌。欢呼，座无虚席 两届亚运会银牌得主扎赫拉·基亚尼 (Zahra Kiani) 是伊朗队的旗手，他希望通过在 YouTube 上观看中国武术比赛的表现，再赢得一枚奖牌。 “我一直在看电影进行训练。我看中国运动员的视频，并尝试模仿他们，”她说。第 20 届亚运会开幕式于 2026 年 9 月 19 日星期六在日本名古屋举行。照片：SF&OC。亚洲奥林匹克理事会表示，这是亚洲大陆最重要的体育赛事，...

This quietness can echo the feelings of those whose hearts are heavy, even amidst grand events. May Yahweh bring healing to the brokenhearted, offering comfort and renewed spirit to all who feel unseen or...
reflection.zh: 名古屋亚运会的开幕式以观众寥寥和气氛沉闷为特点，这似乎表明尽管场面盛大，但反响却不热烈。这种沉寂或许能呼应那些内心沉重之人的感受，即使在盛大的活动中也是如此。愿雅伟医治伤心的人，赐予所有感到不被看见或提不起精神的人安慰和复兴的灵。

verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: How Chinese architect Ma Yansong melds nature with a ‘futuristic feel’
title.zh: 中国建筑师马岩松如何将自然与“未来感”融为一体

summary.en: Chinese architect Ma Yansong aims to spark curiosity with his designs, which blend nature with sleek, modern aesthetics. His work, including the new Lucas Museum of Narrative Art, spans two decades and numerous visually striking projects globally.
summary.zh: 中国建筑师马岩松旨在通过其融合自然与时尚、现代美学的作品激发好奇心。他的作品，包括新近开放的叙事艺术博物馆，横跨二十载，遍布全球，引人注目。

body.en: From a distance, it looks as though a giant spaceship has just landed in the palm tree-dotted streets near downtown Los Angeles. Chinese architect Ma Yansong. Photo: Wikicommons via CC2.0. It could also be a wide-canopied tree or a low passing cloud — but for its Chinese architect Ma Yansong, as long as the building “sparks curiosity”, he’s achieved his purpose. Over the past two decades, Ma has created dozens of visually striking projects in his home country and abroad, integrating nature with sleek, modern designs. In some ways, his seemingly sci-fi-inspired style is a perfect match for his newest project opening on September 22, the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art in Los Angeles, founded by “Star Wars” creator George Lucas and his wife, Mellody Hobson. Lucas Museum of Narrative Art, Los Angeles. Photo: MAD. “The building takes on a futuristic feel that generates excitement,” Ma told AFP at the Beijing office of MAD Architects, the firm he established in 2004. “When people visit the Lucas Museum, they will each bring their own unique perspectives,” said the 50-year-old, who last year was included on Time magazine’s list of the 100 most influential people. “They might catch a beam of light, see it cutting through the building, glimpse the clouds, the sky, or even the cosmos. “This sparks curiosity and new ideas — and those diverse thoughts are incredibly valuable.” Mountains and water A Beijing native, he grew up in a courtyard house typical of the “hutong” alleyways that crisscross the historic centre of China’s capital city. “There was a very close connection to nature,” he said, recalling the trees and small pockets of open space interspersed in hutong neighbourhoods. Quzhou Sports Park, China. Photo: MAD. Later, he went overseas to train as an architect, graduating from the Yale School of Architecture and working briefly at the studio of acclaimed Iraqi-British designer Zaha Hadid. Ma and his firm have conceptualised landmark works all over China, including the Harbin Opera House, a vast, swooping structure perched dramatically on the banks of the frigid Songhua River. Abroad, his notable projects include a pair of twisting residential buildings called the “Absolute Towers” near Toronto, Canada, and a migration-themed museum that opened last year in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. Ma’s architectural vision draws inspiration from traditional Chinese paintings known as “shanshui”, or “mountains and water”, usually depicting natural scenery. Jiaxing Train Station, China. Photo: MAD. The Lucas Museum is closely interwoven with its external environment by lawns, trees, running water and a roof...
body.zh: 从远处看，就像一艘巨大的宇宙飞船刚刚降落在洛杉矶市中心附近棕榈树点缀的街道上。中国建筑师马岩松。照片：维基共享资源，来自 CC2.0。它也可以是一棵树冠宽阔的树，也可以是一片低空飘过的云——但对于中国建筑师马岩松来说，只要这座建筑“激发了好奇心”，他就达到了他的目的。在过去的二十年里，马云在国内外创作了数十个引人注目的项目，将自然与时尚、现代的设计融为一体。在某些方面，他看似科幻风格的风格与他于 9 月 22 日开幕的最新项目——洛杉矶卢卡斯叙事艺术博物馆——由《星球大战》创作者乔治·卢卡斯和他的妻子梅洛迪·霍布森创立的卢卡斯叙事艺术博物馆完美匹配。卢卡斯叙事艺术博物馆，洛杉矶。照片：疯狂。马云在他于 2004 年创立的 MAD 建筑事务所北京办事处告诉法新社：“这座建筑呈现出一种未来感，令人兴奋。”这位 50 岁的人说，“当人们参观卢卡斯博物馆时，他们每个人都会带来自己独特的视角。”去年，他被《时代》杂志评选为 100 名最有影响力的人物。 “他们可能会捕捉到一束光，看到它穿过建筑物，瞥见云朵、天空，甚至宇宙。这会激发好奇心和新想法——这些不同的想法非常有价值。”山与水 他是土生土长的北京人，在一座典型的四合院里长大，这种四合院是纵横交错的中国首都历史中心的典型“胡同”小巷。 “这里与自然有着非常密切的联系，”他回忆起胡同街区中散布的树木和小片开放空间。中国衢州体育公园。照片：疯狂。后来，他出国接受建筑师培训，从耶鲁大学建筑学院毕业，并在著名伊拉克裔英国设计师扎哈·哈迪德的工作室短暂工作过。马云和他的公司构思了中国各地的标志性作品，其中包括哈尔滨歌剧院，这座巨大的、俯冲的建筑引人注目地坐落在寒冷的松花江畔。在国外，他的著名项目包括加拿大多伦多附近的两栋被称为“绝对塔”的扭曲住宅楼，以及去年在荷兰鹿特丹开业的一座以移民为主题的博物馆。马的建筑愿景从中国传统绘画“山水”或“山和水”中汲取灵感，通常描绘自然风光。中国嘉兴火车站。照片：疯狂。卢卡斯博物馆通过草坪、树木、流水和屋顶与其外部环境紧密交织在一起……

reflection.en: Ma Yansong's architectural philosophy centers on sparking curiosity through a blend of nature and futuristic design. This dedication to his craft, aiming to create something meaningful and thought-provoking, echoes the wisdom of entrusting one's endeavors to a higher power, seeking guidance and success in the work of one's hands.
reflection.zh: 马岩松的建筑理念侧重于通过融合自然与未来感的设计来激发好奇心。他对工艺的这种奉献精神，旨在创造有意义且发人深省的作品，呼应了将自己的事业托付于更高力量的智慧，在自己手中成就的事业中寻求指引和成功。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: What Hong Kong cinema can take away from a popular Chinese war film
title.zh: 一部受欢迎的中国战争电影能给香港电影带来什么

summary.en: A Chinese war film, 'Once Upon a Time in the Middle East,' understood to be about the US-led Iraq War, has become a massive box office success driven by word-of-mouth, grossing over $372 million. Its upcoming release in Hong Kong and overseas is expected to reignite geopolitical discussions about Chinese commercial...
summary.zh: 一部被广泛理解为关于美国领导的伊拉克战争的中国战争电影《中东往事》已成为票房现象，主要通过口碑传播，总收入超过3.72亿美元。该片即将在香港和海外上映，预计将重新引发关于中国商业电影进入全球叙事的政治争论。

body.en: In late August, I took my parents to see Once Upon a Time in the Middle East in their small-town cinema on the mainland. Built around an unnamed conflict widely understood to be the US-led Iraq war, the film has become the kind of phenomenon no marketing budget could buy, projected to reach 2.5 billion yuan (US$372.5 million) largely through word of mouth. Its Hong Kong and overseas release will revive geopolitical arguments over a Chinese commercial film entering a narrative world long...
body.zh: 八月下旬，我带着父母去内地小镇电影院看了《中东往事》。这部电影围绕一场被普遍认为是美国领导的伊拉克战争的未命名冲突展开，已成为一种营销预算无法买到的现象，预计票房将达到 25 亿元人民币（3.725 亿美元），主要通过口碑传播。它在香港和海外的上映将再次引发关于一部中国商业电影长期进入叙事世界的地缘政治争论……

reflection.en: The immense popularity of 'Once Upon a Time in the Middle East' highlights how stories can powerfully shape perceptions of conflict. As this film enters new markets, it invites reflection on how narratives of war are told and received, and whether they contribute to cycles of understanding or perpetuate division. May we seek to overcome animosity with...
reflection.zh: 《中东往事》的巨大成功表明，故事能够有力地塑造人们对冲突的看法。当这部电影进入新的市场时，它促使我们反思战争叙事是如何被讲述和接受的，以及它们是促进理解的循环还是加剧分裂。愿我们寻求以促进同情和和平的叙事来克服敌意。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong’s first chief executive, honoured with state funeral
title.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华获颁国葬

summary.en: Hong Kong is holding a state funeral on Sunday for Tung Chee-hwa, its first post-colonial chief executive. This is only the third time a Hongkonger has received such an honor since the 1997 handover. Tung, who passed away at 89 on September 8, led the city through various challenges including the 1997 Asian financial...
summary.zh: 香港将于周日为其首任后殖民时期行政长官董建华举行国葬。自1997年移交以来，这是香港人第三次获此殊荣。董建华于9月8日逝世，享年89岁，他曾带领香港经历1997年亚洲金融危机和2003年SARS疫情等一系列起伏。

body.en: Hong Kong is bidding farewell to its first post-colonial chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, on Sunday at a state funeral – only the third time a Hongkonger has received such an honour since the 1997 handover. Tung, who died at the age of 89 on September 8, led Hong Kong through a series of ups and downs, including the 1997 Asian financial crisis, the 2003 Sars outbreak and the V-shaped economic recovery that followed. Sunday’s funeral follows a vigil held the previous day at the Hong Kong Funeral...
body.zh: 周日，香港在国葬上告别了首任后殖民时代特首董建华——这是自 1997 年回归以来香港人第三次获得这样的荣誉。 9月8日逝世，享年89岁的董建华带领香港经历了一系列风风雨雨，包括1997年亚洲金融危机、2003年非典爆发以及随后的V型经济复苏。周日的葬礼是在前一天在香港葬礼上举行的守夜活动之后举行的。

reflection.en: The state funeral for Tung Chee-hwa marks the closing of a significant chapter in Hong Kong's history. Ecclesiastes reminds us that there is a time for everything, a season for every activity under heaven. This moment of farewell invites reflection on the passage of time and the changing seasons of leadership and governance.
reflection.zh: 为董建华举行的国葬标志着香港历史上一重要篇章的结束。《传道书》提醒我们，天下万物都有定时，万务都有适宜的时节。这个告别的时刻，邀请我们反思时光的流逝，以及领导和治理的更迭季节。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Hong Kong’s political, business elite pay final respects to Tung Chee-hwa
title.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华逝世，政商界精英致哀

summary.en: Hong Kong's political and business elite gathered for a solemn vigil to bid farewell to Tung Chee-hwa, the city's first chief executive. Beijing leaders sent wreaths for his state funeral, and the public signed condolence books, marking a moment of collective remembrance and respect.
summary.zh: 香港政商界精英于周六为香港首任行政长官董建华举行了庄严的守灵仪式，告别这位离世的领导人。北京领导人送来花圈，预示着国葬的到来，公众也纷纷前往社区中心签名吊唁，共同表达哀思。

body.en: Hong Kong’s political and business elite bade a solemn farewell to Tung Chee-hwa, the city’s first chief executive, at a vigil on Saturday, as Beijing leaders sent wreaths ahead of his state funeral and members of the public streamed into community centres to sign condolence books. Hundreds of wreaths lined the pavement at the Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point, spilling into a nearby playground, while inside the hall the mood was hushed as top officials, former politicians and business...
body.zh: 周六，香港政界和商界精英在守夜活动中向香港首任特首董建华庄严告别，北京领导人在国葬前送上花圈，公众涌入社区中心签署吊唁簿。北角香港殡仪馆的人行道上排列着数百个花圈，花圈散落在附近的游乐场，而大厅内的气氛一片寂静，高层官员、前政客和商界人士……

reflection.en: The passing of Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first chief executive, brings a moment of reflection on mortality for many. As leaders and citizens gather to honor his memory, the event reminds us that all earthly lives, regardless of position, eventually face their end, a truth echoed in scripture.
reflection.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华的离世，让许多人有机会反思生命的终结。当领导人和市民聚集在一起纪念他时，这一事件提醒我们，无论地位如何，所有尘世的生命终将走向终点，这是圣经中反复强调的真理。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Evening News on TV32 - Sep 19
title.zh: 电视32台晚间新闻 - 9月19日

summary.en: Top stories for Saturday, Sep 19, 2026 - Chief Executive John Lee says the city’s first five-year plan will not have a revised version. - Political and business leaders pay tribute to former Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa who died last week. - Asian Games have opened in Nagoya.
summary.zh: 2026年9月19日星期六主要新闻 - 行政长官李家超表示，本港首个五年规划不会有修订版本。 - 政商界领袖向刚于上周逝世的前行政长官董建华致敬。 - 亚洲运动会在名古屋开幕。

reflection.en: As leaders gather to honor a former Chief Executive, we are reminded of the profound responsibility that comes with public service. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. May those in positions of influence reflect on these timeless principles, seeking to govern with integrity and compassion for the good of all.
reflection.zh: 当各界领袖聚集向一位前行政长官致敬时，我们被提醒公职服务所带来的深远责任。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的雅伟同行。愿身居要职者反思这些永恒的原则，以诚信和怜悯之心治理，造福大众。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Stunning ceremony opens Asian Games
title.zh: 亚运会盛大开幕

summary.en: The 20th Asian Games commenced on Saturday with a spectacular opening ceremony in Nagoya, Japan, marking the start of the continent's largest sporting event. The ceremony featured a high-tech, colorful show with a giant heart-shaped stage symbolizing unity, headlined by violinist Taro Hakase and followed by the parade...
summary.zh: 第20届亚运会于周六在日本名古屋举行了盛大的开幕式，拉开了亚洲最大体育赛事的序幕。开幕式以高科技、色彩缤纷的表演为特色，设有一个象征大陆团结的巨型心形舞台，由小提琴家 Taro Hakase 领衔，随后是各国代表团入场。

body.en: The 20th Asian Games officially got underway on Saturday with a dazzling opening ceremony in the Japanese city of Nagoya, kicking off the continent's largest sporting event in spectacular style. Japan's Emperor and Empress were given a respectful reception as they took their seats, before the high-tech, colourful show unfolded all-around a main stage uniquely shaped like a giant heart to represent continental unity. Japanese violinist Taro Hakase headlined the ceremony at Paloma Mizuho Stadium, performing from centre field alongside a dynamic group of dancers. A short video showcasing the events of this edition set the stage before delegations from around the world paraded into the stadium. Basketball player Hu Mingxuan and Olympic boxing gold medallist Wu Yu served as flag bearers for the national team, while basketball player Ivan Yang and wushu athlete Lydia Sham led the Hong Kong, China delegation. China has sent a 1,274-member delegation, including 815 athletes set to compete in 38 sports. The SAR sent a delegation of more than 800 members, including about 580 athletes, also competing in 38 sports. The Games will run from September 19 to October 4. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 第二十届亚运会于周六在日本名古屋市举行了令人眼花缭乱的开幕式，以壮观的方式拉开了亚洲最大体育赛事的序幕。日本天皇和皇后入座后受到了尊敬的接待，随后高科技、丰富多彩的表演在主舞台上全面展开，主舞台形状独特，像一个巨大的心形，代表大陆统一。日本小提琴家叶加濑太郎 (Taro Hakase) 在帕洛玛瑞穗体育场 (Paloma Mizuho Stadium) 主持了仪式，并与一群充满活力的舞者一起在中场表演。在来自世界各地的代表团列队进入体育场之前，一段展示本届赛事活动的简短视频奠定了基础。篮球运动员胡明轩和奥运会拳击金牌得主吴宇担任国家队旗手，篮球运动员杨伊万和武术运动员沈殿霞率领中国香港代表团。中国代表团由1274人组成，其中运动员815人，将参加38个大项的比赛。特区派出代表团成员800余人，其中运动员约580人，参加38个大项的比赛。奥运会将于9月19日至10月4日举行。编辑：Azam Khan

reflection.en: The opening of the Asian Games reminds us of the dedication and striving inherent in athletic competition. Like the athletes preparing for their events, we too are called to run our races with perseverance, aiming for a prize that is eternal, not perishable.
reflection.zh: 亚运会的开幕提醒我们，体育竞技中蕴含着奉献和拼搏的精神。就像运动员们为他们的赛事做准备一样，我们也蒙召要以毅力奔跑我们的赛程，目标是那永恒而非易逝的奖赏。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Flawed AI-linked intelligence report almost led to US military boarding Chinese ship in Middle East – report
title.zh: 人工智能报告出错，美军险些在中东登上一艘中国船只

summary.en: An artificial intelligence-assisted intelligence report that was flawed nearly led to the U.S. military boarding a Chinese vessel in the Middle East earlier this year. The operation was called off after officials discovered the AI chatbot had misidentified the ship's cargo.
summary.zh: 今年早些时候，一份由人工智能辅助但存在缺陷的情报报告几乎导致美军在中东登上一艘中国船只。在官员发现人工智能聊天机器人错误识别了船上货物后，该行动被取消。

body.en: The US military came close to boarding a Chinese vessel in the Middle East earlier this year based on a flawed intelligence report prepared with the help of artificial intelligence, CNN said Friday. The US and Chinese flag. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. US intelligence indicated the ship was carrying nuclear weapons-related components, leading American forces to prepare to intercept it, the broadcaster reported, citing four anonymous sources familiar with the incident. But the operation was called off after officials determined that an AI chatbot used by an analyst had misidentified the material the ship was carrying. CNN quoted one source as saying the intelligence report was “entirely false” but “almost started a war.” It did not specify what the vessel was actually carrying or where it was bound. US Central Command — which is responsible for American forces in the Middle East — did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the reported incident. The CNN report comes after a furor erupted earlier this month when a researcher publicly resigned from leading AI firm Anthropic over fears that the technology could escape human control. Another Anthropic employee, who did not resign, said publicly that “we really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans,” and that he thought the chances were greater than “10 percent within the next decade.” Despite the warnings, US President Donald Trump and some of his key allies have voiced opposition to drastically curbing the development of artificial intelligence. US President Donald Trump arrives to deliver remarks on the economy at Mount Airy Casino Resort in Mount Pocono, Pennsylvania, on December 9, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. In a separate incident involving the US military and China, Politico reported Friday that F-35 jet parts — including a sensitive stealth canopy for a cockpit — were diverted to Hong Kong and are now missing, raising fears that Beijing had obtained sensitive American military technology. The parts were headed from Australia to the United States for repairs when the diversion occurred, the US outlet reported, adding that it was unclear why the parts were rerouted or where they are now. A spokesperson for Lockheed Martin, which manages the F-35 supply chain, said the company could not discuss specific shipments because of “security reasons.” “Lockheed Martin follows all US regulations established by the Department of War and regulated by the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) regarding the shipment of aircraft components,” the spokesperson said. “Our teams handle every shipment with the utmost diligence and safeguards to ensure the integrity of the F-35 program and...
body.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 周五称，今年早些时候，美国军方差点登上中东的一艘中国船只，原因是人工智能帮助编写的一份有缺陷的情报报告。美国和中国国旗。资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。该广播公司援引四名熟悉该事件的匿名消息人士的话说，美国情报表明这艘船载有与核武器相关的部件，导致美国军队准备拦截它。但在官员确定一名分析师使用的人工智能聊天机器人错误识别了该船携带的材料后，该行动被取消。美国有线电视新闻网援引一位消息人士的话称，这份情报报告“完全错误”，但“几乎引发了一场战争”。它没有具体说明该船实际运载了什么或开往何处。负责中东美军的美国中央司令部没有立即回应对所报道事件的置评请求。 CNN 的报道是在本月早些时候爆发的，当时一名研究人员因担心该技术可能逃脱人类控制而公开从领先的人工智能公司 Anthropic 辞职，引发了轩然大波。另一位没有辞职的 Anthropic 员工公开表示，“我们确实真诚地相信人工智能可以杀死所有人类”，并且他认为这种可能性“在未来十年内超过 10%”。尽管发出警告，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和他的一些主要盟友仍表示反对大幅遏制人工智能的发展。 2025 年 12 月 9 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达宾夕法尼亚州波科诺山艾里山赌场度假村发表经济讲话。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。在另一起涉及美国军方和中国的事件中，Politico 周五报道称，F-35 喷气式飞机部件（包括驾驶舱的敏感隐形座舱盖）被转移到香港，目前失踪，引发人们对北京获得美国敏感军事技术的担忧。据美国媒体报道，这些零件在发生转移时正从澳大利亚运往美国进行维修，并补充说，目前尚不清楚这些零件为什么要改变路线，也不清楚它们现在在哪里。管理 F-35 供应链的洛克希德·马丁公司发言人表示，由于“安全原因”，该公司无法讨论具体的发货情况。该发言人表示：“洛克希德·马丁公司遵守由战争部制定并由国防后勤局 (DLA) 监管的有关飞机部件运输的所有美国法规。” “我们的团队以最大的勤勉和保障措施处理每批货物，以确保 F-35 计划的完整性并......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence offers incredible potential, but this incident underscores the critical need for human discernment and verification. Even sophisticated tools can err, reminding us that true wisdom involves not just accumulating information, but carefully evaluating its truth and implications.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展带来了巨大的潜力，但这一事件凸显了人类辨别和核实能力的关键重要性。即使是复杂的工具也会出错，这提醒我们，真正的智慧不仅在于积累信息，还在于仔细评估其真实性和潜在影响。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: ‘Forcing a reckoning’: How Asia is preparing for a ‘supersized’ El Niño
title.zh: 亚洲如何为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象做准备

summary.en: Governments across Asia are urgently preparing for the most severe El Niño event on record, anticipating widespread droughts, wildfires, typhoons, and floods. This extreme weather, exacerbated by human-driven climate change, is expected to bring multiple crises, including heat, heavy rain, and food shortages, to...
summary.zh: 亚洲各国政府正紧急为有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象做准备，预计将出现大范围的干旱、野火、台风和洪水。这种由人为气候变化加剧的极端天气，预计将从现在到2027年给数亿人带来包括高温、暴雨和粮食短缺在内的多重危机。

body.en: From Sri Lanka to South Korea, governments are preparing for droughts, wildfires, typhoons and floods – with climate plans facing their biggest challenge to date Asian governments are rushing preparations for the most severe El Niño weather event on record, with hundreds of millions of people bracing for multiple crises at once as extreme heat, heavy rain and food shortages hit the region. Fuelled by exceptionally warm ocean conditions across the tropical Pacific – and developing alongside the human-driven climate crisis – El Niño is virtually guaranteed to grow to a very strong intensity towards the end of this year and into 2027. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从斯里兰卡到韩国，各国政府正在为干旱、野火、台风和洪水做准备——气候计划面临迄今为止最大的挑战。亚洲各国政府正在加紧准备，应对有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺天气事件，随着极端高温、暴雨和粮食短缺袭击该地区，数亿人同时面临多重危机。在热带太平洋异常温暖的海洋条件的推动下，并与人类造成的气候危机一起发展，厄尔尼诺现象几乎肯定会在今年年底和 2027 年增长到非常强烈的强度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Asia braces for the impacts of a 'supersized' El Niño, the scale of potential devastation—droughts, wildfires, floods—underscores humanity's vulnerability to natural forces. In such times, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer a profound reminder: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This truth offers solace and a call to...
reflection.zh: 随着亚洲为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象的影响做准备，潜在破坏的规模——干旱、野火、洪水——凸显了人类在自然力量面前的脆弱性。在这样的时刻，诗篇46:1古老的言语提供了一个深刻的提醒：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”这个真理在风暴聚集之时，为人们提供了慰藉，并呼唤人们寻求坚定不移的希望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
